scenarios.summary: A real master session initializes the project, writes and searches memory, creates topics through both canonical and alias tools, routes an intent into a briefed topic session, then reads the bounded status and notice ledger.

A routed topic creates an isolated work item, reports progress, proposes a decision, requests authorization, asks a question, submits a plan, and requests a user review; the panel routes authorize, answer, approve, pass, move, archive, and reopen the topic.

A topic commits an isolated work item, requests an independent review, the reviewer session runs its own check and passes it, the topic hands off, and the master merges the reviewed range without moving main.

A reviewer returns needs_revision with a finding, the topic commits a fix and re-requests the review, and the next reviewer rejects the range, blocks the topic, and writes the review-reject inbox record.
The real provider initializes the project and routes one topic; the index and panel state are the observation. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and --mode live.
The scripted model drives a real topic session to commit through the host bash tool; it requires a usable bash sandbox backend and is observational, not keyless evidence.

A master session registers README.md as a work item; the panel routes list, read, annotate, save, report presence, upload and serve an attachment, consume the live SSE stream, and rebind the record after the file moves; the dispatched annotation is replied to by the scripted model and the reply closes the batch.

The real provider registers a work item from the master and another from a routed topic, answers an annotation carrying a solid-red image (the colour word proves the image prompt), and honours cowork_artifact_reply for both dispatches so two sessions are in flight together. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and --mode live.

A project already holds a previous run's dispatch logs (one in-flight and one queued) before the work-item runtime exists; the first artifact read runs recovery, which marks the in-flight batch stale without a new prompt and reschedules the queued batch until the scripted model replies.
